text: One page, telling a story at a glance — that's a Power BI dashboard, and it's the last piece of this chapter.
Chapter Eight's whole discipline — headline number first, everything else supporting it — was preparing you for exactly this. A dashboard is that discipline, built as an actual Power BI object.
Tiles get pinned from reports, and reports sit on semantic models. A dashboard can pull tiles from more than one report, and more than one semantic model, into a single consolidated view.
Dashboards and reports differ in real ways: one page instead of many, no filtering at all, never available in Desktop, but dashboards do support alerts on individual tiles.
That closes Chapter Nine. Chapter Ten, Refresh and Gateways, covers how these published semantic models actually stay current.
